test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 14 Oct 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Six friends, Tanay, Neha, Kalpana, Raashi, Hemant and Chaitra, are standing in a row. There are two persons between Neha and Chaitra. Kalpana is between Raashi and Neha. Hemant is standing beside Chaitra. Neha is at one of the ends of the row. Who is standing between Chaitra and Tanay?
solution:
Six friends: Tanay, Neha, Kalpana, Raashi, Hemant and Chaitra.

Neha is at one of the ends of the row.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c8e3260306affc971fccf8fd3be69f815028011ba384a8b5cf55fd055ad5c8a7.png] 

There are two persons between Neha and Chaitra.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2c2acb30725d5c75fd5352e44b4b498b957e01f9823bf3389d250b46f29559ea.png] 

Kalpana is between Raashi and Neha.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/22e87c2807780b8eb7f4d140c3995ed5868eec973412fe784a7164a72075fe9b.png] 

Hemant is standing beside Chaitra. Thus the final arrangement is given below -

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/47f608e54eaf9c901e2f160e6683fa7395b85969e85fc5d1faf86d115cf4145c.png] 

Hemant is standing between Chaitra and Tanay.

Hence, **"option 3"** is the correct answer.
